scope: Scoped UI guidelines for 4 home cards clickability & preflight device check box styling

colors.theme: Existing black/blood-red dark theme, unchanged home card palettes

home_cards.requirement: Make all 4 home screen cards (3 exam cards + 1 All India series banner) clickable so clicking anywhere on the card container navigates to the respective main exam page (/exams/jee-main, /exams/bitsat, /exams/comedk, /series/all-india-jee).
home_cards.event_isolation: Ensure inner buttons, links, toggles, and modals stop propagation (e.g. e.stopPropagation()) so secondary actions (like 'Pause shine', shortcut links, or modal triggers) remain independently interactive without triggering the parent card click.
home_cards.hover_effect: Maintain smooth hover lift (transform: translateY(-4px)) and border highlight.

preflight_device_check_box.requirement: In SetDetail.js preflight step 02 (Check & begin), enclose the 'Check my device' section inside a clear, distinct visual container box.
preflight_device_check_box.cta_guidance: Provide a prominent 'Click here' CTA text/badge or button wrapper on the Check My Device action, preserving the underlying check + consent start gate logic and data-testid attributes.
preflight_device_check_box.styling: Background: #1D1117; Border: 1px solid #713648; Padding: 20px (16px mobile); Border-radius: 14px; preserve the existing dark theme.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard JavaScript React syntax (.js files) - DO NOT use TypeScript types or .tsx extensions.

For the 3 exam cards in ExamNavigation.js, wrap or attach an onClick handler to the main <article> / <Card> container that navigates to the primary exam page using react-router useNavigate or absolute card link overlay, while calling e.stopPropagation() on inner shortcuts (<nav> links) and controls.

For LiveSeriesBanner.js, make the flagship banner card clickable to navigate to SERIES_PATH ('/series/all-india-jee'), keeping the 'Explore the series' button and live badge modal triggers functioning via stopPropagation.

In SetDetail.js, enclose the existing check action, help and progress in a dark bordered device-check-callout with Click here. Keep the sample/input and actual preflight/consent/start logic unchanged.
Preserve all existing data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='preflight-run-check', data-testid='exam-home-exam-card-jee-main', etc.).
Do NOT add new imagery, claims, or overhaul the global visual redesign.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.accessibility: Ensure focus rings (focus-visible) and contrast ratios pass APCA / WCAG standards.
